name: What should I do if my shower drain is completely clogged?

mainEntity.name: What should I do if my shower drain is completely clogged?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your shower drain is completely clogged and water is not draining at all, avoid using chemical drain cleaners as they can damage pipes or cause hazardous fumes. First, try a plunger to dislodge the blockage. Ensure there's enough water to create a seal, then plunge firmly. If this doesn't work, consider carefully removing the drain cover and attempting to pull out any visible hair or debris with pliers or a drain snake. If the clog persists after these attempts, it's best to contact a professional plumber. Alpha-Plumbing Services can diagnose and safely clear severe clogs.
acceptedAnswer.description: For a completely clogged shower drain, try plunging first. Avoid chemical cleaners. If unsuccessful, call a professional plumber.
